entities.summary: Dmitriy Zakharovich Manuilsky or Dmitro Zakharovych Manuilsky was an important Bolshevik revolutionary, Soviet politician and academic who was Secretary of the Executive Committee of the Communist International from December 1926 to its dissolution in May 1943.
